eaf4f222302640f7.title: Google's Documentation Refresh Offers Ideas For SEO Content Updates via @sejournal, @martinibuster
eaf4f222302640f7.cover_headline: Google just rewrote their own docs. Here's why.
eaf4f222302640f7.cover_body: Their edits show exactly what makes content easier to rank.

slides.headline: Vague → precise
slides.body: Google swapped "responds quickly" for "response times remain stable." General fluff got cut. Specifics stayed.

slides.headline: "Server errors" is now "5xx codes"
slides.body: Every fuzzy term got a concrete replacement. "Every URL" → "every publicly accessible URL." Details matter.

slides.headline: Cut the "why," show the effect
slides.body: Old: "calculated to provide coverage." New: "ensures Google can cover." Readers want outcomes, not explanations.

slides.headline: Comprehension road bumps
slides.body: Sentences with clashing ideas make readers re-read. Google removed them. If humans pause, so does their algorithm.

slides.headline: Short ≠ clear
slides.body: Not about sentence length. One idea per sentence, logically ordered. That's what Google actually fixed.

eaf4f222302640f7.cta_headline: Clearer pages. But are visitors staying?
eaf4f222302640f7.cta_body: Good content gets them there — LeadYup turns that attention into contacts before they bounce.

slides.headline: "Sorry, just saw this"

slides.headline: Route leads to where you actually look

slides.headline: Automate the handoff, not the reply

22bfca807db64e9f.title: Трафик есть, заказов нет — как поднять конверсию
22bfca807db64e9f.cover_headline: Traffic's fine. Sales aren't. Now what?
22bfca807db64e9f.cover_body: 5 conversion leaks you're probably ignoring right now

slides.headline: Visitors browse. Then vanish.
slides.body: 97% of site visitors leave without doing anything. Your ad budget brought them in — then the site let them walk.

slides.headline: Stop asking for the sale first
slides.body: Lead with value: a quiz, a guide, a discount code. Get the email before they ghost. Sell later.

slides.headline: Quiz beats contact form
slides.body: "Find your perfect [product]" gets clicks. "Contact us" gets ignored. Interactive means engaging means converting.

slides.headline: Catch exit intent
slides.body: Cursor moves to close tab? That's your last shot. A popup with a real offer can recover 5-15% of leaving visitors.

slides.headline: More ads ≠ more sales
slides.body: Doubling ad spend doubles traffic — and doubles waste if your site still leaks. Fix the bucket before you pour more water.

22bfca807db64e9f.cta_headline: You're paying for traffic that leaks out
22bfca807db64e9f.cta_body: LeadYup adds quizzes, popups, and lead magnets to your site — so visitors become contacts before they disappear.
